status: FROZEN structure (release candidate 1). Subcategories, definitions, examples and seed pool are fixed for R1-R6. Final name `taxonomy_v1` only after the gold-standard acceptance rule is met.

l2.definition: Handbags, shoulder bags, evening bags, bum bags and small fashion bags carried as personal accessories.
l2.boundary: Includes children's character bags and Charlotte bags; excludes cosmetic/toiletry bags, travel bags, shopping totes and storage bags.

l2.definition: Bags, baskets and folding aids used for household organization, laundry and recycling.
l2.boundary: Includes peg bags, drawstring bags, recycling bags, folding shirt tidies and laundry baskets; excludes gift, fashion, cosmetic, travel and shopping bags.

l2.definition: Large reusable bags designed for shopping and carrying groceries or goods.
l2.boundary: Includes cotton or fabric shopper bags; excludes lunch bags (lunch_bag) and travel bags (travel_bags_luggage).
examples: JUMBO BAG PINK WITH WHITE SPOTS

l2.definition: Insulated or non-insulated bags designed to carry packed meals and snacks.
l2.boundary: Includes lunch bags with handles or zippers; excludes jumbo shopper bags (jumbo_shopper_bag) and lunch boxes (lunch_box_cutlery).

l2.definition: Bags and cases designed for travel, including cabin bags, airline bags, and picnic bags.
l2.boundary: Includes luggage and travel bags; excludes jumbo shopper bags (jumbo_shopper_bag) and lunch bags (lunch_bag).
examples: AIRLINE BAG VINTAGE JET SET RED

l2.definition: Zip or pouch bags designed to store toiletries, makeup and small personal care items.
l2.boundary: Includes washbags, cosmetic and make-up bags and toiletry pouches; excludes purses and wallets (purse_wallet) and drawstring or laundry bags (household_laundry_storage).

l2.definition: Decorative strings of flags or paper shapes used to adorn spaces for celebrations.
l2.boundary: Includes paper or fabric garlands and bunting; excludes individual hanging ornaments (hanging_ornaments).

l2.definition: Disposable paper or foil cups used to line muffin or fairy cake tins.
l2.boundary: Includes baking paper liners; excludes reusable cake tins (baking_tools) and paper napkins/cups (party_tableware).
examples: PACK OF 60 PINK PAISLEY CAKE CASES
60 GOLD AND SILVER FAIRY CAKE CASES

l2.definition: Disposable or decorative items for parties, including party bags, balloons, invitations, and candy cones.
l2.boundary: Includes party favours and decorations; excludes party tableware (party_tableware) and bunting/garlands (bunting_garland).

l2.definition: Disposable paper or plastic tableware for parties, such as napkins, plates, and cups.
l2.boundary: Includes paper napkins and paper cups; excludes reusable plates (plates) and party bags/supplies (party_bags_supplies).

l2.definition: Holders, plates, or lanterns designed to safely contain candles or tea lights.
l2.boundary: Includes candle plates and tea light holders; excludes string lights (lights_lamps) and incense holders (incense).

l2.definition: Candles made or decorated for display rather than standard lighting: figural and novelty shapes, candles in decorative cups or teacups, and pebble or ball candles.
l2.boundary: Includes shaped and novelty candles, cup/teacup candles and decorative candle sets; excludes tealights (tealight_candles), dinner, taper and pillar candles (dinner_taper_pillar_candles) and scented jar or tin candles (scented_candles).

l2.definition: Standard cylindrical, tapered, or pillar candles used in holders/candelabras for dining, church, or general lighting; includes dinner, taper, pillar, church, and advent candles.
l2.boundary: Includes items with DINNER, TAPER, PILLAR, CHURCH, ADVENT, or standard round/rectangular/cube candle formats. Excludes tealights, shaped/figural candles, and scented container candles.
examples: S/4 BLUE DINNER CANDLE SILVER FLOCK

l2.definition: Incense sticks and cones and other non-candle home-fragrance items: incense holders, oil burners, fragrance oils and scented sachets.
l2.boundary: Includes incense, incense holders, oil burners, fragrance oils and sachets, and incense-and-candle sets; excludes candles (the four candle subcategories) and candle holders (candle_holder_lantern).

l2.definition: Lighting products including string lights, lamps, and lampshades for illumination or decoration.
l2.boundary: Includes fairy lights and lampshades; excludes candle holders (candle_holder_lantern) and non-electric lanterns.
examples: BLUE ORGANDY ROUND LAMPSHADE W BEA

l2.definition: Candles marketed primarily for fragrance, usually in glass, tin, jar, or box; includes scented container candles and scented gift sets.
l2.boundary: Includes items with SCENT or fragrance in the name that are not tealights, dinner/taper/pillar, or shaped novelty candles. Tealights, even if scented, go to tealight_candles.
examples: ROSE SCENT CANDLE IN JEWELLED BOX
S/3 ROSE GARDEN SCENT SQU CANDLE

l2.definition: Small tea light candles in cups, typically sold in sets; includes all t-light/tea-light items regardless of scent or decorative design.
l2.boundary: Includes any item named T-LIGHT, T-LIGHTS, TEA LIGHT, or small candle sets in cups. Excludes larger candles, dinner/taper/pillar, and scented container candles.

l2.definition: Wearable clothing and footwear (slippers, socks, scarves, hats, dresses, baby bibs) and hand-held fans.
l2.boundary: Includes slippers, socks, scarves, sun hats, children's clothing, bibs and fans; excludes knitting kits (sewing_craft), sock puppets (soft_toys), rainwear (umbrella_rainwear) and hand warmers (hand_warmer).

l2.definition: Items designed to style, hold, or decorate hair, such as clips, slides, combs, hairbands, hair ties, and hair grips.
l2.boundary: Includes all hair clips, slides, combs, hairbands, hair ties, hair grips, and hair bands. Excludes ear muffs and headwear not intended for hair styling.

l2.definition: Portable items that generate heat to warm hands, often reusable.
l2.boundary: Includes pocket warmers and reusable hand warmers; excludes gloves and clothing/slippers (clothing_slippers).

l2.definition: Fashion jewellery worn on the body, including necklaces, bracelets, earrings, rings, brooches, and jewellery sets.
l2.boundary: Includes all items that are primarily worn as body adornment (necklaces, bracelets, earrings, rings, brooches, jewellery sets). Excludes hair accessories, bag/phone charms, key rings, and jewellery display stands.

l2.definition: Small attachable accessories: keyrings and key fobs, bag and phone charms, and luggage tags.
l2.boundary: Includes keyrings, key fobs, bag charms, phone charms and luggage tags; excludes jewellery worn on the body (jewellery) and gift tags (gift_wrap_tags).
examples: AMBER BERTIE GLASS BEAD BAG CHARM

l2.definition: Purses, wallets, coin purses and card or passport holders for carrying money and documents.
l2.boundary: Includes purses, wallets and passport covers; excludes toiletry and cosmetic bags (wash_cosmetic_bags), handbags (fashion_handbags) and keyrings (keyrings_tags).

l2.definition: Umbrellas, parasols and rainwear such as ponchos and rain hats.
l2.boundary: Includes folding umbrellas, decorative parasols, ponchos and rain hats; excludes other clothing (clothing_slippers) and paper cocktail parasols (party_tableware).

l2.definition: Decorative and functional items for gardens and outdoor spaces, such as birdhouses, plant cages, and garden markers.
l2.boundary: Includes garden ornaments and plant holders; excludes indoor vases/planters (vases_planters) and pet bowls (pet_items).

l2.definition: Items for pets, particularly feeding bowls and related accessories.
l2.boundary: Includes dog and cat bowls; excludes human kitchen storage (kitchen_storage) and garden decor (garden_outdoor).

l2.definition: Artificial flowers, stems, and floral garlands for decorative use.
l2.boundary: Includes artificial flowers, floral picks, leis; excludes fresh flowers and potted live plants.

l2.definition: Reusable writing/notice boards including blackboards, chalkboards and memo boards, with or without an easel.
l2.boundary: Use for plain writing surfaces (blackboards, chalkboards, memo boards); boards whose main function is storage with hooks or pockets go to hooks_racks_shelves; worded decorative signs go to wall_signs.

l2.definition: Timepieces designed for wall or tabletop display.
l2.boundary: Includes wall clocks and table clocks; excludes watches or alarm clocks not intended as decor.

l2.definition: Cushions, cushion covers and other soft-furnishing textiles such as throws.
l2.boundary: Includes filled cushions and cushion covers; excludes kitchen and table textiles (kitchen_textiles), bath towels (bath_beauty), hot water bottles (hot_water_bottle) and doorstops (doorstops_paperweights).

l2.definition: Decorative signs, number tiles, and door hangers used for identification or display.
l2.boundary: Includes number/letter tiles and door signs; excludes wall art (wall_art) and hanging ornaments (hanging_ornaments).

l2.definition: Mats placed at entrances to wipe shoes and protect floors.
l2.boundary: Includes indoor/outdoor doormats; excludes bath mats and pet mats.

l2.definition: Weighted items used to hold doors open or keep papers in place.
l2.boundary: Includes decorative doorstops and paperweights; excludes tabletop decorations (tabletop_decorations) not designed as weights.

l2.definition: Small furniture such as cabinets, drawer units and side, occasional or coffee tables, plus furniture hardware such as drawer knobs and handles.
l2.boundary: Includes cabinets, drawer units, small tables, drawer knobs and pulls; excludes wall shelves and hooks (hooks_racks_shelves), storage baskets (storage_baskets_decor), table linens (kitchen_textiles) and TV tray tables (serving_trays_platters).

l2.name_zh: 悬挂装饰（含圣诞树挂饰）
l2.definition: Ornaments designed to be hung from a tree, branch, hook, window or wall, for any season: tree decorations, baubles, hanging hearts, stars and birds, and mobiles.
l2.boundary: Includes tree decorations, baubles, hanging hearts, stars and birds, and mobiles; excludes garlands and bunting (bunting_garland), wreaths (wreaths), freestanding figures (tabletop_decorations) and hanging candle holders (candle_holder_lantern). Season is recorded separately and does not change the subcategory.

l2.definition: Wall-mounted or hanging hardware for hanging and storing items such as coats, keys, and magazines.
l2.boundary: Includes coat hooks, shelving units, and magazine racks; excludes freestanding cabinets (furniture_knobs) and doorstops.

l2.definition: Containers filled with hot water and often covered with fabric, used to provide warmth.
l2.boundary: Includes hot water bottles with covers; excludes hand warmers (hand_warmer) and cushions.
examples: PINK HEART DOTS HOT WATER BOTTLE

l2.definition: Reflective surfaces for viewing oneself, available as wall-mounted or handheld/compact styles.
l2.boundary: Includes wall mirrors and compact mirrors; excludes photo frames (photo_frame_album) and mirrored wall art (wall_art).

l2.definition: Frames for displaying photographs and albums for storing them.
l2.boundary: Includes photo frames and photo albums; excludes mirrors (mirrors) and wall art (wall_art).

l2.name_zh: 装饰收纳篮与玩具收纳
l2.definition: Woven, wicker, wooden or fabric baskets, chests and tidies for storage or display, including toy tidies and picnic baskets.
l2.boundary: Includes storage and picnic baskets, nesting basket sets, wooden chests and toy tidies; excludes laundry and peg bags (household_laundry_storage), food tins and jars (kitchen_storage) and small trinket boxes (trinket_jewellery_box).

l2.definition: Freestanding small decorative objects for display on tables, shelves, or mantels.
l2.boundary: Includes figurines and small seasonal decorations; excludes hanging ornaments (hanging_ornaments) and candle holders (candle_holder_lantern).

l2.definition: Decorative small boxes, pots and trays for jewellery and small items: jewellery boxes, trinket pots and trays, jewellery stands, sewing boxes and tissue box covers.
l2.boundary: Includes jewellery boxes, trinket pots and trays, jewellery stands, sewing boxes and tissue boxes; excludes gift boxes (gift_boxes), food storage tins and jars (kitchen_storage) and storage baskets (storage_baskets_decor).

l2.definition: Vases, posy holders, plant pots and planters for cut flowers or plants, including wall and hanging planters.
l2.boundary: Includes vases, posy holders, indoor plant pots and planters; excludes small trinket pots (trinket_jewellery_box), garden ornaments and tools (garden_outdoor) and candle holders (candle_holder_lantern).

l2.definition: Decorative pieces designed to be mounted on walls, including mirrored art and plaques.
l2.boundary: Includes wall plaques and mirrored wall art; excludes mirrors (mirrors) and hanging ornaments (hanging_ornaments).
examples: FRUIT TREE AND BIRDS WALL PLAQUE

l2.definition: Decorative or novelty signs with printed text or motifs for wall or shelf display, including metal signs, calendar signs, and signs with single hooks.
l2.boundary: Use for non-door signs with wording or motifs; excludes chalkboards/memo boards and non-text decorative wall art. Calendar signs and cupcake single-hook signs stay here because the sign is the primary object.

l2.definition: Decorative wooden letters or words used for display on shelves, walls, or tables.
l2.boundary: Includes freestanding or wall-mountable wooden letters/words; excludes door signs (door_hangers_signs) and wall art (wall_art).

l2.definition: Ring-shaped decorative arrangements made of foliage, flowers, twigs, or other materials, typically hung on doors or walls.
l2.boundary: Include all items with WREATH in the description, regardless of material or season. Exclude wreath-shaped card holders or functional items not intended as display wreaths.

l2.definition: Items used for baking, including cake tins and cookie cutters.
l2.boundary: Includes baking pans, moulds, and cutters; excludes general kitchen utensils (kitchen_tools) and disposable paper cases (cake_cases).

l2.definition: Open-top round containers used for serving or eating food, including mixing bowls, fruit bowls, pudding bowls, and snack bowls.
l2.boundary: Includes all bowl-shaped items for food, even if decorative (e.g. fruit bowls, sundae dishes, finger bowls). Excludes plates, flat dishes, trays, and pet bowls (assigned to pet_items).

l2.definition: Elevated plates or stands used to display and serve cakes and desserts.
l2.boundary: Includes glass, metal, or ceramic cake stands; excludes general serving plates (plates) and tabletop decorations (tabletop_decorations).

l2.definition: Small protective mats or discs placed under drinks or tableware to protect surfaces.
l2.boundary: Includes all coasters and placemats regardless of material/design. Excludes trays and tablecloths.

l2.definition: Items used to hold boiled eggs upright or cover them to keep warm.
l2.boundary: Includes egg cups and knitted/felt egg cosies; excludes general kitchen tools (kitchen_tools) and tableware (plates).

l2.definition: Containers such as tins, jars, and bread bins used to store food or kitchen items.
l2.boundary: Includes biscuit tins, glass jars, and bread bins; excludes decorative storage boxes (trinket_jewellery_box) and baskets (storage_baskets_decor).
examples: JARDIN ETCHED GLASS LARGE BELL JAR

l2.definition: Fabric items for the kitchen and dining table: tea towels, aprons, oven gloves, tablecloths and table runners.
l2.boundary: Includes tea towels, aprons, oven gloves, tablecloths, table runners and fabric napkins; excludes paper napkins (party_tableware), bath towels (bath_beauty) and cushions (cushions_textiles).
examples: SET OF 2 FANCY FONT TEA TOWELS

l2.definition: Handheld tools and utensils used for cooking, serving, or eating.
l2.boundary: Includes spoons, spatulas, chopsticks, and small pans; excludes baking-specific tools (baking_tools), kitchen storage (kitchen_storage), and tableware (plates, mugs_cups).

l2.definition: Containers for packed meals, often with accompanying mini cutlery sets.
l2.boundary: Includes lunchboxes with cutlery and standalone mini cutlery sets; excludes lunch bags (lunch_bag) and full-size kitchen utensils (kitchen_tools).
examples: BLUE 3 PIECE MINI DOTS CUTLERY SET

l2.definition: Drinking vessels intended for hot beverages such as tea and coffee.
l2.boundary: Includes mugs, coffee cups, and saucers; excludes teapots/coffee pots (teapot_tea_set) and disposable paper cups (party_tableware).

l2.definition: Flat or shallow dishes used for serving or eating food.
l2.boundary: Includes dinner plates, cake plates, and pizza plates; excludes cake stands (cake_stand) and disposable paper plates (party_tableware).

l2.definition: Large flat or slightly raised items with handles or rims used to carry or present multiple food items, including trays, platters, and TV dinner trays.
l2.boundary: Includes items designed to carry multiple servings or used as a base for serving; excludes individual plates, bowls, and tableware sets. TV tray tables with stands are included due to their tray function.

l2.definition: Decorative accessories for table settings, such as napkin charms, napkin rings, and place card holders.
l2.boundary: Includes napkin rings and place setting decorations; excludes actual plates/cutlery (plates, kitchen_tools) and party tableware.

l2.definition: Teapots, coffee pots, tea sets and matching tea-time serving pieces such as milk jugs, sugar bowls and tea, coffee or sugar caddies.
l2.boundary: Includes teapots, coffee pots, multi-piece tea sets, milk jugs, sugar bowls and tea caddies; excludes single mugs and cup-and-saucer items (mugs_cups) and general food storage tins (kitchen_storage).

l2.definition: Towels, soap holders, and bath sponges used for personal care in the bath or shower.
l2.boundary: Includes bath linens and bath accessories; excludes kitchen textiles (kitchen_textiles) and tissues (tissues_plasters).

l2.definition: Kits and supplies for sewing, felt craft, and similar handmade projects.
l2.boundary: Includes sewing kits and felt doll kits; excludes art supplies (pens_pencils_art) and finished textile products.

l2.definition: Disposable paper tissues and adhesive bandages for personal hygiene and first aid.
l2.boundary: Includes pocket tissue packs and plasters; excludes bath sponges (bath_beauty) and kitchen towels (kitchen_textiles).

l2.definition: Decorative boxes used to present gifts, sometimes with a small item included.
l2.boundary: Includes pre-filled gift boxes; excludes gift wrap/tags (gift_wrap_tags) and decorative storage boxes (trinket_jewellery_box).
examples: BLUE DIAMANTE PEN IN GIFT BOX

l2.definition: Wrapping paper, tape, and tags used to wrap and label gifts.
l2.boundary: Includes rolls/sheets of wrap and gift tags; excludes gift boxes (gift_boxes) and greeting cards (greeting_cards).

l2.definition: Greeting cards, postcards, notelets and envelopes for occasions and messages.
l2.boundary: Includes single cards, card packs, postcards, notelets and envelopes; excludes gift tags (gift_wrap_tags), card games such as snap cards (games_puzzles) and card holders (tabletop_decorations).

l2.definition: Decorative magnets designed to attach to refrigerators or other magnetic surfaces.
l2.boundary: Includes fridge magnets in sets or singles; excludes magnetic hooks or tools.

l2.definition: Bound paper products for writing, note-taking, or sketching.
l2.boundary: Includes notebooks, journals, and sketchbooks; excludes greeting cards and stationery sets.

l2.definition: Writing and drawing instruments and related art materials.
l2.boundary: Includes pencils, pens, and erasers; excludes notebooks (notebooks_journals) and craft kits (sewing_craft).

l2.definition: Adhesive decorative stickers and temporary tattoos for personalising items or skin.
l2.boundary: Includes paper and 3D stickers; excludes gift wrap/tags (gift_wrap_tags) and magnets (magnets).

l2.definition: Tabletop board games, card games, matching/top trumps games, bingo, dominoes, jigsaws and puzzle blocks.
l2.boundary: Includes classic and licensed card/board games and jigsaw puzzles. Excludes outdoor/garden skittles, croquet, flying discs, traditional action toys and construction/play figure sets.

l2.definition: Ceramic, wooden or novel money boxes, piggy banks and coin banks used for saving money.
l2.boundary: Includes items described as money box, money bank, piggy bank or coin bank. Excludes tins that are for storage even if stacking/nesting (kitchen_storage).
examples: CERAMIC HEART FAIRY CAKE MONEY BANK

l2.definition: Toys designed for outdoor or physical active play, including garden games, windmills, flying toys, skittles, skipping ropes, catch cups, spinning tops and similar.
l2.boundary: Includes garden croquet, skittles, flying discs, gliders, toy helicopters, windmills, inflatable globes/balls, skipping ropes and traditional action toys. Excludes tabletop board/card games and jigsaw puzzles.

l2.definition: Small play figures, dollhouse room sets and pretend-play tool sets, including single figurines and multi-piece sets.
l2.boundary: Includes multi-piece animal/dinosaur/creepy crawly sets, dollhouse furniture rooms, and child's role-play tool sets. Excludes soft toys, board/card games, puzzles and outdoor toys.

l2.definition: Stuffed, plush and soft knitted toys including teddies, soft dolls, soft animals and character plush.
l2.boundary: Includes items described as soft toy, teddy, plush/knitted doll or soft animal. Excludes feltcraft doll kits (sewing_craft), doorstops shaped like dolls/animals, money boxes, and decorative wall plaques such as flying ducks.
